project_type: pnpm monorepo: React+Vite frontend + Express 5 API + PostgreSQL
build_system: pnpm workspaces, esbuild for API, vite for frontend
test_framework: No test files found - no test suite exists
verification_instructions: Validate CloudFormation template syntax, validate Docker build, verify nginx config syntax
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No DATABASE_URL available for build-time DB access. Object Storage uses Replit sidecar which won't exist in AWS - media storage will need adaptation in production.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Standard project conventions apply.
key_patterns: API server: Express 5 on PORT env var, builds to dist/index.mjs via esbuild. Frontend: Vite, needs PORT and BASE_PATH env vars, builds to dist/public/. DB: Drizzle ORM with node-postgres, uses DATABASE_URL env var. Auth: JWT with JWT_SECRET env var. Frontend API client uses relative paths (no base URL needed when same-origin or reverse-proxied). Stripe integration for payments. GCS/Replit Object Storage for media (needs adaptation for AWS S3 in production).
directory_structure: Root: pnpm monorepo. artifacts/api-server/ - Express API built with esbuild to dist/index.mjs. artifacts/creatools/ - React frontend built with Vite to dist/public/. lib/db/ - Drizzle ORM schemas and DB connection. lib/api-spec/ - OpenAPI spec. lib/api-client-react/ - Generated React Query API client. lib/api-zod/ - Generated Zod schemas.
